stemMd: The author would most likely agree that a scientifically improved flood model

options.label: A
options.textMd: may change estimated risks without by itself settling the proper building requirement.

options.label: B

options.label: D

explanationMd: The final paragraph explicitly separates improved estimates from decisions about required expense. A model informs policy but does not alone supply the value judgment about which precautions are proportionate.

distractorRationale.e: Better models still require transparent assumptions.
distractorRationale.d: Cost-benefit judgment is distinct from hazard estimation.
distractorRationale.c: The passage permits justified decision thresholds.
